name: io.github.kensaurus/lazycow
title: Lazycow Studio
description: Drive Lazycow Studio by kensaurus: make reels and trip films from your footage, plan and post them.

environmentVariables.name: STUDIO_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The studio's port (default: the studio's .env, else 4317)

environmentVariables.name: STUDIO_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The studio's API token, only if you set one (default: read from the studio's .env)

environmentVariables.name: LAZYCOW_DIR
environmentVariables.description: The studio folder, if it is not where the double-click setup put it
